{
  "tables": ["card", "client", "disp", "loan", "district"],
  "columns": [
    "client.client_id",
    "client.gender",
    "client.birth_date",
    "card.type",
    "EXTRACT(YEAR FROM card.issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM client.birth_date) AS age_at_issue",
    "COUNT(loan.loan_id) AS number_of_loans",
    "SUM(loan.amount) AS total_amount_borrowed",
    "CASE WHEN COUNT(loan.loan_id) > 0 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM card.issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM client.birth_date) < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN COUNT(loan.loan_id) > 0 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS borrower_classification",
    "district.a2 AS district_name",
    "district.a11 AS district_average_salary",
    "RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY client.gender ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM card.issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM client.birth_date)) AS age_rank"
  ],
  "filters": [
    {
      "table": "card",
      "column": "issued",
      "op": ">=",
      "value": "1994-01-01"
    },
    {
      "table": "card",
      "column": "issued",
      "op": "<",
      "value": "1995-01-01"
    }
  ]
}
